Compulsive Audio 19 products » About Compulsive Audio Compulsive Audio is run (and founded) by John De Luca, who also designs and builds the pedals. The company is located in Sparta, a small town in the NW region of NJ, USA. Timeline (by John De Luca) Summer 2009 - Compulsive Audio was founded  Early part of 2010, we moved from making pedals on the kitchen table to a shop in the garage.
